label: Couple
description: Who a romantic couple is: a man and a woman, two women or two men.
notes: Seeds a couple's variants, one value per variant, drawn by its shares: a man and a woman 90%, two women 5%, two men 5%. A couple's words narrow it ('lesbian couple' keeps two women; 'husband and wife' keeps a man and a woman). A value's short form is the words its variant must say of who they are. Not a slot's list: the reader never binds a slot to it.
